# ServiceNow Architecture

Use this skill for ServiceNow-specific architecture.

## Procedure

1. Define catalog or intake experience.
2. Define workflow states, approvals, tasks, changes, incidents, and fulfillment records.
3. Define IntegrationHub, REST, connection aliases, credential aliases, and MID Server needs.
4. Define CMDB, CSDM, ownership, and audit model.
5. Define SNOW-Terraform and SNOW-Vault interfaces.
6. Ensure sensitive values do not persist in variables, work notes, attachments, import sets, logs, or CMDB.
7. Document failures, retries, rollback, and support.
8. For HLD or solution-doc extraction, keep only architecture/design aspects and compress generic business or appendix content.

Use [SNOW architecture template](../../../templates/snow-architecture.md).

Use [ServiceNow architecture/design template](../../../templates/enterprise/servicenow-architecture-design.md) when the user asks for HLD, high-level design, solution document extraction, client review, or ServiceNow design document content.
